description: A React custom hook 'useRequests' managing access requests workflow with Supabase backend, including functions for submitting, fetching, and updating access requests, with role-based access and notifications.

methods.name: normalizeTier(tier)
methods.description: Normalizes tier input into accepted values ('public', 'qualified', 'nda') or null.

methods.name: normalizeStatus(status)
methods.description: Normalizes status input into accepted values ('pending', 'approved', 'denied', 'revoked', 'withdrawn') or null.

methods.name: isTableMissingError(error)
methods.description: Detects if an error message indicates a missing table in the database.

methods.name: toRequestModel(r)
methods.description: Converts raw database record into a cleaned request object with standardized fields.

methods.name: applyAdminFilters(query, { status, tier, email, search, limit } = {})
methods.description: Builds a filtered query for admin view based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: useRequests()
methods.description: Main React hook providing state, loading, and CRUD operations for access requests with role-based permissions.

methods.name: refreshAll
methods.description: Loads all requests with optional filtering; available for admins/founders.

methods.name: submitRequest
methods.description: Allows an investor to submit an access request.

methods.name: updateRequestStatus
methods.description: Generic updater to change a request's status (e.g., approve, deny, revoke, withdraw).

methods.name: revokeRequest
methods.description: Reverts an approved request to revoked state.

methods.name: withdrawRequest
methods.description: Allows an investor to withdraw their own pending request.

ctags.name: applyAdminFilters
ctags.pattern: /^function applyAdminFilters(query, { status, tier, email, search, limit } = {}) {$/
